name: Aperture
author: tomismeta
description: The human-attention layer for OMP on Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Turn typed OMP events into NOW, NEXT, and AMBIENT human attention with exact pane focus.

schema.label: Start with details hidden
schema.description: Replaces rendered OMP text with neutral placeholders. Focus identity and ordering are unchanged.

schema.label: Open Aperture shortcut (display only)
schema.description: Shows your global shortcut in the notification and tooltip. Defaults to the recommended Super + A; does not bind keys.

schema.label: Ambient detail
schema.description: Summary shows up to three canonical ambient rows; expanded shows every ambient row supplied by ApertureCore.
